author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (F13B, village election, Greta, paraphrase)
notes: Formulation B, domain politics: independent re-phrasing of the ten meaning units of F13A in both languages (same events, same order, same name Greta). The rival is 'her opponent' / 'ihr Konkurrent', the sealed box becomes a locked chest ('Truhe'), the recount a 'second count' / 'zweite Zählung'. Unit 1 uses the reflexive 'sich bewerben um' (non-separable), unit 9 'bestehen auf' with dative. No separable verbs. Subjects vary between the protagonist, other people (opponent, rivals, residents, teacher, council members) and an event (the first tally). Unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
